dedupe_keys.name: model weights for watch this space securing satellite communication through resilient transmitter fingerprinting

description: The SatIQ team deposits twelve trained H5 weight files for satellite-transmitter fingerprinting models used in the 2023 "Watch This Space" study. The final model is identified as ae-triplet-final.h5; other weights correspond to additional experiments. The linked public repository contains data collection, model-training and analysis code, and explicitly points to its v1.0.2 tag for this earlier paper. These weights could support authentication or spoofing-resilience scenarios for Iridium communication links. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this weight release. The Zenodo files carry CC BY-NC 4.0, while the linked repository reports GPL-3.0; users must keep these rights distinct. A limitation is that training and evaluation require the separately deposited labelled message data and substantial computing resources. The current repository main branch targets a later paper and is not assumed compatible with these archived weights. No model file was downloaded or loaded, and classification accuracy was not reproduced.
